home.importedRoute.description: Header above the route alternatives card when a single route was imported from a GPX file or share-extension link.

home.noSuggestions.description: Empty-state placeholder shown in the where-to dropdown when the typeahead has no results yet.

home.platformHint.locationDefault.description: Hint shown under the 'Allow GPS in background' setting on every browser except Safari/iOS. Phrased platform-neutrally (no 'browser' / 'page') so it can be reused on iOS and Android in future without sounding off.

home.platformHint.locationSafariIos.value: Safari sur iPhone ne fournit pas une localisation GPS réellement en arrière-plan. Gardez l’onglet actif et l’écran allumé pour que les mises à jour de localisation continuent pendant que vous roulez.

home.recenter.description: Map button to recenter on the rider's current location.

home.startingOnDevice.description: Transient state on the start button while the route is being transferred to a paired ESP32 device.

home.stop.description: Short label on the floating Stop button on the active-guidance card. Distinct from `home.stopRoute` because the floating CTA only has room for one word.

home.stopRoute.description: Button to end the active route session.

home.suggestedRoutes.description: Header above the route alternatives card when the planner has computed multiple route options.

home.whereTo.description: Search bar placeholder on the home screen.

home.workingOnRoute.description: Status label shown while the planner is computing the route.

planning.cyclingAlternatives.description: Notice on the route alternatives card when all OSM cycling sources succeeded. BRouter and OSRM are tool/brand names and must not be translated.

planning.cyclingAlternativesWithFailures.description: Notice on the route alternatives card when one or more OSM cycling sources timed out or errored. {failedCount} is the number of failed sources.

planning.mixedRoutesFromHslAndOsm.value: Itinéraires mixtes via HSL et OSM
planning.mixedRoutesFromHslAndOsm.description: Notice shown above the route alternatives card when results combine HSL Digitransit and OSM-derived providers. HSL and OSM are brand names — do not translate.
